title: Blazers' Damian Lillard is Different on The Court, Says REVOLT TV Personality
htmlContent:
Not only is Portland Trailblazers' guard Damian Lillard one of the cover athletes on NBA 2k21, but he also had a hand in curating this year's soundtrack.

Just another accomplishment on his resume this season, Lillard has been balling this season, averaging 30 points, 4.3 rebounds, and 8.0 assists per game through 66 games.

He also earned his 5th All-Star nod earlier this season. After the three-month hiatus due to COVID-19, Lillard led his team into the playoffs and was named the Bubble MVP.

"I have a lot of respect for Dame. Obviously he is a five point guard, but he might be closer to being top 3. He is ballin. I respect his musical abilities as well, he can definitely flow a little bit," said Ro$$ Mac on the Catch The Wave Podcast.

"One of my homies Jeremiah has a couple of songs with him. So, I have definitely been in tune before he got on this 2k. So, I rock with Dame heavy, he different on the court. I rock with him super heavy."
